messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up for token validation failures. Need owners + deadlines for remediation and to capture recurring patterns.
Sam: List the open actions? I can take alerting and logging changes.
Jorge: From notes: 1) audit log gaps on token denies 2) stale auth cache allowing invalid tokens 3) runbook + synthetic smoke checks 4) secrets rotation verification.
Priya: Also: 5) permissions-drift detection and 6) manual scrub script for known bad tokens.
Maya: Proposed deadlines: audit logging by Tue (3d), cache TTL hardening by Fri, runbook/synthetics by next Wed, rotation verification by EOW. Sound OK?
Sam: Tue is tight but doable; will need eng-infra help for retention and structured fields.
Jorge: Ill take cache TTL work. Plan: make TTL explicit in auth-proxy, add unit + integ tests. Target Fri.
Priya: Ill create a smoke check every 5m; fail if token validation latency >300ms or error rate >0.5%. Target next Wed.
Maya: @sec-bot please schedule rotation verification weekly.
sec-bot: scheduled weekly rotation scan (cron: 0 02 * * 1). report -> #security-weekly. ticket SEC-4821 created.
Maya: Sam, paste minimal CLI to pull audit logs so Jorge can confirm the gap.
Sam: gcloud: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=gae_app AND protoPayload.methodName=\"AuthorizeToken\"" --limit 1000 --format json`
Sam: aws: `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/auth --filter-pattern "AuthorizeToken" --limit 1000`
Jorge: Running those now against yesterday; will attach results to GH-5020.
Maya: We saw two incidents in 6 weeks with cache-stale + deploy overlap. Propose metric: deploy-time token validation failure rate >0.2% for 10m -> alert.
Sam: +1, will add to dashboard and wire PagerDuty severity 2.
Jorge: Ops scrub script: keep manual until reviewed. Ill review before merge.
Priya: Marked manual-run and adding tests.
Maya: Ownership recap: Audit logs & retention -> Sam -> due in 3d -> GH-5021; Cache TTL -> Jorge -> due Fri -> GH-5020; Runbook + synthetic -> Priya -> due next Wed -> GH-5033; Rotation verification -> SecOps/sec-bot -> weekly -> SEC-4821; Permissions drift -> Maya/Security -> plan next sprint; One-off scrub -> Ops -> TBD (review Jorge).
Sam: pinging @eng-infra for retention quota. PR for logging fields opened -> PR #736.
sec-bot: audit scan complete  7 mismatches found, follow-ups in SEC-4821.
Priya: Will tune synthetic thresholds based on mismatches.
Maya: Next sync Thu 10am if needed; otherwise use thread for quick 1-line progress updates.
Sam: PR #736 landed (logging fields).
Jorge: GH-5020 updated with log snippet; cache TTL not reset during hot deploys.
Priya: Runbook PR #739 opened (includes synthetic config + steps).
Maya: Posting exec status update tomorrow with owners and dates. Tagging this thread as remediation checkpoint. Thanks all :thumbsup:
